requirements.heading: Base64
requirements.text: The values that are base64 encodings MAY contain folding whitespace (FWS) for formatting purposes as per the usual header field wrapping defined in [MAIL].

requirements.heading: ARF Extension for Authentication Failure Reporting
requirements.text: Multiple reports MAY be used to report multiple failures for a single message.

requirements.heading: New ARF Feedback Type
requirements.text: Furthermore, [ARF] specifies this field is OPTIONAL and appears at most once; for this extension, this field MUST be present, but it MUST reflect only a single authentication method's result.

requirements.heading: New ARF Feedback Type
requirements.text: Furthermore, [ARF] specifies this field is OPTIONAL and appears at most once; for this extension, this field's inclusion is RECOMMENDED, where that value is available, to aid in diagnosing the authentication failure.

requirements.heading: New ARF Feedback Type
requirements.text: Furthermore, [ARF] specifies this field is OPTIONAL and appears at most once; for this extension, this field MUST be present if such a value is available.

requirements.heading: New ARF Feedback Type
requirements.text: This field is OPTIONAL, but it MUST NOT appear more than once.

requirements.heading: New ARF Feedback Type
requirements.text: If present, it SHOULD indicate the outcome of the message in some meaningful way, but it MAY be set to "other" for local policy reasons.

requirements.heading: New ARF Feedback Type
requirements.text: This part MUST be included (contrary to [REPORT], which makes it optional).

requirements.heading: Optional for All Reports
requirements.text: It MUST NOT appear more than once.

requirements.heading: Optional for DKIM Reports
requirements.text: The encoded content MUST be limited to those octets that contribute to the DKIM body hash (i.e., the value of the "l=" tag; see Section 3.7 of [DKIM]).

requirements.heading: Optional for DKIM Reports
requirements.text: If DKIM-Canonicalized-Header and DKIM-Canonicalized-Body encode redacted data, they MUST NOT be included.

requirements.heading: Optional for DKIM Reports
requirements.text: Otherwise, they SHOULD be included.

requirements.heading: Required for ADSP Reports
requirements.text: This MUST be formatted per Section 4.2.1 of [ADSP].

requirements.heading: Required for SPF Reports
requirements.text: SPF-DNS: This field MUST appear once for every SPF record [SPF] used to obtain the SPF result.

requirements.heading: Required for SPF Reports
requirements.text: It MUST include the DNS RRTYPE used, the DNS domain from which the record was retrieved, and the content of that record.

requirements.heading: Authentication Failure Types
requirements.text: The DKIM-ADSP-DNS field MUST be included in the report.

requirements.heading: Authentication Failure Types
requirements.text: The DKIM-Canonicalized-Body field SHOULD be included in the report (see Section 3.2.4).

requirements.heading: Authentication Failure Types
requirements.text: The DKIM-Domain and DKIM-Selector fields MUST be included in the report.

requirements.heading: Authentication Failure Types
requirements.text: The DKIM-Domain and DKIM-Selector fields MUST be included in the report, and the DKIM-Canonicalized-Header field SHOULD be included in the report (see Section 3.2.4).

requirements.heading: Authentication Failure Types
requirements.text: Supplementary data MAY be included in the form of comments compliant with [MAIL].
